message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: CI Build

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [ main, 'issue/**' ]

permissions: read-all

jobs:
  build-java:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        java-version: [ base, main ]
    name: Build project
    runs-on: ${{ vars.ACTION_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Setup Java and Maven
        uses: spring-projects/spring-data-build/actions/setup-maven@main
        with:
          java-version: ${{ matrix.java-version }}
          develocity-access-key: '${{ secrets.DEVELOCITY_ACCESS_KEY }}'
      - name: Prepare Docker Container Licenses
        run: ./ci/accept-third-party-license.sh
      - name: Cache Maven packages
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.m2/repository
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-maven-${{ hashFiles('**/pom.xml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-maven-
      - name: Build
        uses: spring-projects/spring-data-build/actions/maven-build@main
        env:
          OSS_ARTIFACTORY_USR: '${{ secrets.ARTIFACTORY_USERNAME }}'
          OSS_ARTIFACTORY_PSW: '${{ secrets.ARTIFACTORY_PASSWORD }}'
          COMMERCIAL_ARTIFACTORY_USR: '${{ secrets.COMMERCIAL_ARTIFACTORY_USERNAME }}'
          COMMERCIAL_ARTIFACTORY_PSW: '${{ secrets.COMMERCIAL_ARTIFACTORY_PASSWORD }}'
        with:
          additional-options: '-Pall-dbs'
          settings-xml: '${{ vars.SETTINGS_XML }}'
",
  "rationale": "The workflow builds a Maven project across two Java versions. Adding a Maven dependency cache step (actions/cache@v4) for ~/.m2/repository, keyed on all pom.xml files, can avoid repeated dependency downloads and significantly reduce build time. This is supported by experimental evidence (experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-a89d5fd8d30bc8cb-r2) showing a 51% elapsed time reduction for a similar Maven workflow, and by the literature pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE which reports modest aggregate benefits for caching dependency downloads. The change preserves all existing build and test coverage, adds no privileged actions or network access, and respects the repository's required checks.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-a89d5fd8d30bc8cb-r2", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
